verdict.rationale: Fin Procedures are documented as a way to train Fin to handle queries with multiple steps, business logic and third-party systems from start to finish. A dedicated 'Building Fin Procedures' help article exists, and a 'Run a procedure' endpoint is available in the Preview API, which together cover the core of encoding SOPs for known issue types. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that branching is deterministic rather than model-interpreted, detail on how branch conditions are authored (the help articles appear only as titles), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
